summary: Request: 30 temporary Postman Pro seats for QA contractor sprint + SCIM/Okta automation
description:
Issue summary:
We need to procure 30 temporary Postman Pro seats for a timeboxed QA contractor cohort supporting the Payments integration sprint. Seats should be enterprise-managed (SCIM-enabled) and integrated with our Okta org so contractors receive accounts automatically and are deprovisioned at the end of the sprint.

Impact:
QA contractors cannot run shared collection runs or use monitored mock servers without Pro seats. Delays blocking end-to-end testing for the Payments feature could push go-live by 1–2 weeks.

Environment / Scope:
- Target users: 12 external QA contractors + 18 overflow internal testers (30 seats total)
- Duration: 6 weeks (preferred start 2026-03-23 through 2026-05-04)
- Billing: charge to ENG-OPS-42 cost center

Requested deliverables:
1) Purchase/commit for 30 Postman Pro seats (temporary, 6-week term or invoice credit)
2) SCIM provisioning app configuration for Postman in Okta, mapping for email, first/last name, and groups tag 'contractor-qa-postman'
3) Automated deprovisioning rule tied to contractor offboarding group in Okta
4) Vendor contact and PO/contract reference stored in procurement tracker

Required-by date: 2026-03-23

Vendor info (preliminary):
- Vendor: Postman, Inc.
- Sales rep: emily.sanders@postman.com
- SKU: Postman Pro (team/enterprise inquiry)
- Initial quote requested 2026-03-13 (awaiting formal quote)
justification: Timeboxed need to allow external QA contractors to run shared Postman collections, use monitors, and collaborate on tests. Expected velocity improvement and risk reduction for Payments integration rollout.

investigation_notes:
- Identity reviewed Postman SCIM docs and confirmed mapping for email, displayName, groups.
- Procurement probed for temporary term pricing; vendor offered a prorated enterprise credit option rather than per-seat monthly billing.
- Potential automation: use Okta group 'contractor-qa-postman' synced from HR/Access platform to drive provisioning.
- Risk: If vendor cannot provide prorated 6-week billing, finance will need to approve either full monthly invoice or we accept manual reimburse/credit.
- No open security blockers identified; data residency falls under vendor standard.
- Linked internal ticket INT-25789 contains prior seat-pool orchestration notes that may be reusable.
resolution: Pending - procurement PO has been drafted and sent to Finance for approval (2026-03-19). Identity team ready to configure SCIM once vendor provides enterprise tenant and admin connector details. Next update scheduled by 2026-03-21.
